item.title: AgCenter entomologists try to bring back fireflies
item.description: Christine Gambino photo LSU AgCenter entomologists are trying a few different ideas to rebuild firefly populations at Wetland Trace, including planting native plants and pollinators. Around the country, firefly populations have reached historically low numbers. At one time, they lit up the night with their blinking mating calls.
